en.title: The Chatty Diver and the Secret Frozen Sweets Shop
en.premise: Running an antique shop in a seaside town is my pride and joy—especially when it comes to hunting down rare collectibles! One day, I manage to acquire a "seafloor ruin relief" reportedly found in the deep sea. That single item ends up leading me to a strange café tucked away at the edge of town that looks just like an "ice castle." Though the place is freezing cold to the eye, the sweets they serve possess a magical flavor that warms you right to the core! Surrounded by delicious treats and a slightly mysterious quest, my lively and mouth-watering daily life is about to begin!

zh.title: 话痨潜水员与秘密冷冻甜品店
zh.premise: 在海边小镇经营一家古董店的我，人生最大的乐趣就是搜寻珍奇的古董！有一天，我入手了一块据说是在深海中发现的“海底遗迹浮雕”，而这竟成了一个契机，让我开始频繁光顾镇子边缘一家宛如神秘“冰之城堡”的咖啡馆。那里的外观虽然冰冷刺骨，但端出来的甜品却有着能温暖心灵的魔法滋味！被美食与带点不可思议的寻物之旅所环绕，热闹又美味的每一天即将拉开帷幕！
